description: This file defines the class 'youtrackrestInterface', which implements an interface for interacting with YouTrack issue tracker system via REST API. It includes methods for connecting, retrieving issues, checking issue IDs, adding issues, and configuration handling. The class extends a base 'issueTrackerInterface' and is used within a larger bug tracking or issue management integration context.

classes.name: youtrackrestInterface
classes.description: Class for interacting with YouTrack via REST API, managing issues, connection, and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface with configuration and attempts to connect.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client object used for communication with YouTrack.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a given issue ID.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the YouTrack system using provided configuration.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection to YouTrack is established.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves issue details from YouTrack given an issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Gets the status code of a specified issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a verbose, HTML-formatted status string for a specified issue ID.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for configuring the YouTrack interface.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and normalizes the configuration object with default values.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug ID exists in YouTrack.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in YouTrack with a given summary and description.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via API based on current configuration.
